slides.title: Introduction
paragraphs: The world is shifting towards renewable energy solutions as a sustainable future becomes increasingly important. Renewable energy is derived from natural resources that are abundant and continuously replenished, making it key to a safer, cleaner, and more sustainable world.
bullets: Label: The United Nations emphasizes the importance of renewable energy in powering a safer future

slides.title: Key Concepts
bullets: Solar Energy: Harnessing the power of sunlight to generate electricity
Wind Energy: Utilizing wind turbines to convert kinetic energy into electricity
Hydropower: Tapping into the energy potential of water to generate electricity
Energy Efficiency: Improving the way we use energy to reduce waste and consumption

slides.title: Current Situation
paragraphs: According to the ScienceDirect, renewable energy is expected to increase from 11% today to 28% of the total primary energy consumed worldwide by 2050.

Wind Power: Utilized in wind farms to generate electricity on a large scale
Hydropower: Tapped into for electricity generation in hydroelectric power plants
